bagPolicy.summary: Clear totes up to 12" x 6" x 12" and clutches up to 4.5" x 7" are allowed. Other bags larger than a clutch are not allowed.
allowed: Clear totes up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Clear drawstring bags up to 12" x 12"
Items related to a medical condition
prohibited: Bags larger than 4.5" x 7", including purses, backpacks and binocular cases
Boxes, gift bags or wrapped packages
bagPolicy.note: Policies may vary by event, so check the event page for show specific rules.

parking.summary: Parking surrounds the arena in multiple lot quadrants. Guests should use the official parking map and event instructions for the assigned area.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Accessible pickup and drop-off is available in the circle drives on the east and west sides of the building.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: All State Farm Center concession transactions are cashless.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is available in each parking-lot quadrant around the arena. The venue provides accessible seating and may arrange sign-language interpretation with advance notice.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: State Farm Center has a no-re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The Illinois Ticket Office is in the main lobby of State Farm Center, open Monday through Friday from 12 PM to 5 PM, and on weekends only on show or game days and on-sale dates. Will call is at the Ticket Office windows, and the person named on the order must show a valid photo ID.

gates.summary: The arena uses upper-concourse ramps and east and west lower entrances; door assignments and opening times vary by event.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
